calculateBondDiscount(uint256,uint256,ui.notice: Calculates progressive lockup discount, tiered staking bonus, and fee splits for bond purchase.

calculateDeposit(uint256,bool,uint8).notice: Calculates deposit entry fee and scales USDC (6 decimals) to 18-decimal USD value.

calculateHealthFactor(uint256,uint256,bo.notice: Calculates Health Factor ratio and checks liquidation condition (HF < 115% or Expired).

calculateLoanTerms(uint256,uint256,uint2.notice: Calculates loan origination fees, maximum 70% LTV borrow capacity, and simple interest.

calculateProofOfReserves(uint256,uint256.notice: Validates 100% solvency requirement (Total Assets USD >= Total Liabilities USD).

calculateRagequitPenalty(uint256).notice: Calculates early exit 15% penalty and splits for ragequitting a bond.

calculateRedemption(uint256,uint256,uint.notice: Calculates gross USD entitlement, exit fee, and net tokens returned for a redemption.

calculateSharesToMint(uint256,uint256,ui.notice: Calculates exact ALPHA Shares to mint for a deposit given current NAV and shares supply.
